domain: Collegiate Sailing Competitions and Performance Tracking
scenario:
A collegiate sailing league is developing an advanced platform to manage and track sailing competitions across multiple universities. The system will centralize data on sailing events, including details about the races, participating teams, results, and individual sailor performance. The platform will cater to various stakeholders such as coaches, athletes, and league administrators, providing them with detailed analytics and insights into performance trends.

The system must support the management of multiple regattas held at different hosts, detailing the date, teams involved, and results for each race. It should track individual sailor positions in various divisions and provide historical performance data. This will enable coaches to analyze performance over time, make informed decisions for team selection, and strategize for future competitions.

Additionally, the platform should feature comprehensive user management to facilitate access by different roles, such as athletes, coaches, and league officials. It should include reporting tools for generating competition summaries and performance reports. The platform will also support the integration of external data sources to enhance analytical capabilities and provide real-time updates during live events.
